mapper.sql: select 'note' type,concat('',id) id,title,update_time updatedAt from px_note where create_by=#{owner} and del_flag=1 union all select 'webArticle' type,concat('',id) id,title,update_time updatedAt from px_web_article where create_by=#{owner} and del_flag='1' union all select 'file' type,concat('',id) id,display_name title,update_time updatedAt from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and del_flag=1
mapper.select: select * from () d order by updatedAt desc,type,id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select id from px_notepx_web_article where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner} and del_flag=1 for update

choose.when: update px_note set del_flag=0,revision=revision+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,update_by=#{owner}, folder=case when exists(select 1 from px_note_folder f where f.id=px_note.folder and f.create_by=#{owner} and f.del_flag=0) then folder else 0 end where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner} and del_flag=1
choose.otherwise: update px_web_article set del_flag='0',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,update_by=#{owner} where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner} and del_flag='1'
